caption: The drawing depicts a woman in period clothing pushing a three-wheeled carriage. The carriage is predominantly red, featuring gold-colored decorative patterns on the side and a matching interior seat. It has two large black spoked wheels at the rear and a smaller black spoked wheel at the front. The woman wears a long, pleated dress with puffed sleeves in tan and light brown tones, accented by vertical stripes and patterns, and red shoes. Her hands, which are gloved in red, are holding the black handles of the carriage. Her hair is dark and styled up, and her facial features are clearly defined. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or decorations.
title: Go-Cart and Doll
